    • isValid

      public boolean isValid()
      Determines if the subscription is currently valid. May be a cached result and isFromCache() will return true if so. You can use other available properties to determine if you will allow the user to use your full featured app with a cached result.
      Returns:
      true if the subscription is valid, false otherwise

    • getDaysTrialRemains

      public int getDaysTrialRemains()
      Determines the number of full days remaining in the trial period. This is useful for showing the user a countdown message. Note: 6 days, 59 minutes, 59 seconds will return 6 days.
      Returns:
      the number of full days remaining in the trial period, will always be >= 0
